cards.text: Jesus is teaching in the temple, and some of the Jews listening have just believed Him. So He turns to those believers and tells them what it takes to follow Him. Lean in, friend, because this one gets HEATED.

cards.question: What does Jesus tell these believers makes them truly His disciples?

cards.text: Then He promises them, "Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free." Free! You'd think a crowd would cheer for that one.
Nope. They push back on that word, free. "We are Abraham's descendants," they answer. Abraham, the forefather of Israel, from way back in Genesis.

cards.question: As Abraham's descendants, they ask how Jesus can talk about setting them free. They say they have never been ___ to anyone.
Jesus answers with "Truly, truly." He says there's a slavery the crowd hasn't noticed. Who does He say is a slave to sin?

cards.text: Sin's sneaky like that. It's the snooze button. You hit it thinking YOU'RE in charge of your morning. Nine snoozes later... friend, who's running the show?
Then Jesus paints a picture. A house, with two people living in it: a slave, and a son.

cards.question: In Jesus's picture, the slave and the son both remain in the house forever.
Jesus brings the picture home. He tells them that if the ___ sets you free, you will be free indeed.

cards.text: Jesus says, "I know you are Abraham's descendants." Then He names what's really going on. They're trying to kill Him.

cards.question: Jesus tells the crowd why they're trying to kill Him. What reason does He give?

answers.text: His word has no place in them
He healed on the Sabbath day

cards.text: Jesus says He speaks of what He has seen in the presence of the Father. And they do what they've heard from their father. Two fathers. Keep an eye on that.

"Abraham is our father," they reply. Jesus says if they were Abraham's children, they'd do the works of Abraham. It's like a gym card in your wallet. Carrying it around doesn't mean you've lifted ANYTHING.

cards.question: Jesus says Abraham also tried to kill a man who told him the truth from God.

cards.text: Jesus tells them they're doing the works of their father. They fire right back: "We are not illegitimate children."

cards.question: Then the crowd names the only Father they say they have. Who do they name?
Jesus says He came from God and God sent Him. So if God were their Father, they would ___ Him.

cards.text: Then Jesus asks them, "Why do you not understand what I am saying?" And He answers it Himself. They're unable to accept His message.

cards.question: Jesus says the crowd belongs to another father, a murderer from the beginning and the father of lies. Who does He name?
Jesus says the reason the crowd doesn't believe Him is that He speaks the truth.

cards.text: Then Jesus asks, "Which of you can prove Me guilty of sin?" Friend, I could NEVER ask a room that. Mags would answer before I finished the sentence.

cards.question: Jesus says whoever belongs to God hears the words of God. What reason does He give for why the crowd doesn't hear?

answers.text: They do not belong to God
They were never taught the Law

cards.text: Jesus just told them they don't belong to God. The crowd answers, and they stop arguing the point and start calling names. Every group chat on earth has seen THAT move.

cards.question: The crowd asks if they're right to call Jesus two things. What are they?

answers.text: A Nazarene who breaks the Law

cards.question: Jesus says He does not have a demon. What does He say He does instead?

cards.text: Jesus says He doesn't seek His own glory. There's One who seeks it, and He is the Judge.
Then Jesus says, "Truly, truly, I tell you, if anyone keeps My word, he will never see death."

cards.question: When the crowd hears that anyone who keeps Jesus's word will never see death, they say now they know He has a demon.

cards.text: Their reason: Abraham died, and so did the prophets. I bet they thought that settled it right there.

cards.question: Then the crowd asks Jesus a pointed question about Abraham. What do they ask?

answers.text: If He is greater than Abraham
If He is a son of Abraham
If He is sent by Abraham

cards.text: Jesus answers that if He glorifies Himself, His glory means nothing. The One who glorifies Him is His Father, the One they call their God.

cards.question: Jesus says that if He claimed not to know the Father, He would be a liar.

cards.text: Then Jesus brings up Abraham again, the one they keep calling their father. He says Abraham rejoiced, and he was glad.

cards.question: Jesus says Abraham rejoiced that he would see Jesus's ___. He saw it and was glad.

cards.text: The crowd can't believe it: "You are not yet fifty years old, and You have seen Abraham?" You can HEAR the eyebrows go up. Trust me. I know eyebrows.
Then Jesus declares, "Truly, truly, I tell you, before Abraham was born, I am!" Not "I was." I am.

cards.question: At this, the crowd picks up ___ to throw at Jesus.
With stones in the crowd's hands, how does Jesus get out of the temple area?

answers.text: He was hidden and went out

findings.problem: The three stops are well under the target size: stop 1 has 10 cards, stop 2 has 13 and stop 3 has 16. That is 39 cards across 29 verses, which would fit in two stops of about 18 to 20 cards each. Stop 1 is especially thin.

rule.text: About 18 cards per stop, story cards and choice cards together. No more than 20.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
